title: A Bride's Story Manga Gets New Volume Under New Publisher This Winter
content:
The third volume of Kaoru Mori 's Shirley ( Shirley Medison ) manga, the first new volume in 12 years for the manga, announced on Wednesday that the author's A Bride's Story ( Otoyome-Gatari ) manga will have a new volume.

The new volume will be titled Otoyome-Gatari Zoku no 1 ( A Bride's Story Continues 1), and will debut in winter. The volume will contain three new chapters, and will have about 80 pages. The volume will be printed at a larger A4 size. As with the third Shirley volume, new publisher Yukiwarisō (Hepatica, Inc.) will release the new volume. The new chapters will not be serialized in a magazine first.

Mori plans to publish at least a 16th volume once enough chapters are completed. Kadokawa will continue to digitally publish the manga from the 16th volume onward.

The third volume of Shirley also announced that Shirley will also get new editions of the manga's first and second volumes, which will match the style of the new third volume (including the manga's new Shirley Medison title). Mori's earlier Victorian maid manga Emma will also have a planned collector's edition release.

The 24th A and B issues of Kadokawa 's Aokishi magazine in February 2025 announced a renewal of the magazine, which saw some works continuing and other works going in a different direction. Among those works, both Mori and manga creator Aki Irie would no longer have their works published in the magazine. The magazine issues previously stated that Mori "plans to search for a new form of publication" for her manga, and also confirmed Irie would continue her works in the future.

Both A Bride's Story and Irie's Go with the Clouds, North by Northwest had moved to Aokishi from the Harta magazine when the former launched.

Mori ( Emma , Shirley ) launched A Bride's Story in 2008 in Kadokawa 's Fellows! (later Harta ) magazine. Yen Press is releasing the manga in English. The manga's 15th compiled book volume shipped in Japan in November 2024, and Yen Press released the volume in December 2025.

title: 3 Great Anime Making Their Return on Fall 2026’s First Weekend (#2 Makes Its Comeback After 5 Years)
content:
The Fall 2026 season is going to start this weekend, and it is already shaping up to be one of the best seasons of the year, especially excelling in one aspect of anime . Every season this year has followed its own pattern, with Winter filled with great returning anime, Spring packed with new ones, and Summer standing out on its own. Now, the Fall season is aiming to be a mix as well, with many great new anime debuting, but it is the return of the epics that stands out as its specialty.

JoJo ‘s new part is already airing this season; however, starting this Friday, fans are going to see the epic return of everyone’s favorite drama, while Saturday will see the return of one of the greatest shonen series ever, and finally, Sunday will feature Netflix’s best romantic shonen series.

3) The Apothecary Diaries Season 3

The first anime to return is the third season of everyone’s favorite drama anime, The Apothecary Diaries , with Season 3 arriving on Friday, October 2, with a worldwide premiere on the streaming platform Crunchyroll. The series has emerged as one of the best new seinen anime, depicting a very peculiar narrative since its arrival in 2023. Every year since then has featured new episodes of the anime, and now the third season will continue Maomao and Jinshi’s new adventure outside the Inner Palace.

Continuing the narrative, fans will get to see a new outlook on the series as the unfamiliar places add their own intrigue to the political drama. The teasers so far have also introduced new characters, only adding to the political schemes, while national threats are also hinted to be in place. With a split two-cour format, The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 will amuse fans in the Fall of this year, as well as in Spring 2027.

2) Black Clover Season 2

Black Clover ‘s return with Season 2 is undoubtedly the most anticipated return of Fall 2026 , as fans have been hoping for its return for years, and now, five years after the anime’s constant serialization came to an end, fans will finally get to see it pick up where it left off. The anime will arrive this Saturday, October 3, worldwide on Crunchyroll, much like many other anime. The return will mark the beginning of the Spade Kingdom arc that fans have been wanting to see animated for years.

The approach for the highly anticipated Season 2 by Studio Pierrot aims to follow the same pattern as Bleach ‘s final season, meaning fans will get to see some pretty fast-paced episodes with high quality, unlike the first season of the anime. This means fans probably won’t be seeing a long run of hundreds of episodes like the first season had. Instead, fans can expect at best two major split cours, with 25–30 episodes covering the remaining source material of the manga, with the first cour arriving this Fall and the second likely in the Summer of next year.

1) Blue Box Season 2

The final popular anime returning in the first week of Fall 2026 is also Shonen Jump’s most unique sports-and-shonen mix series, Blue Box . Much like Black Clover , its manga came to an end earlier this year, bringing an epic run to a close, but the anime will continue to ignite the series’ spark by continuing its intriguing narrative. The first season came to an end with a variety of dynamics, including setting up a long triangle with Hina involved in the matter.

Now, the second season is going to elevate its narrative in a totally different way by introducing an intriguing character who is associated with Chinatsu’s past but is not on good terms with her. The trailers have showcased Taiki trying to fill the gap and make things right, but it won’t be easy, and with the tension of sports and romance, the upcoming season is also going to include the tension of friendship, adding another perfect slice-of-life element. The anime arrives on Sunday, October 4, on Netflix worldwide regions , making it the epic return of the first weekend of Fall 2026.

title: Bless TV Anime Casts Kentarō Kumagai
content:
The official website for the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga revealed in a character promotional video on Thursday that Kentarō Kumagai will voice MM in the series.

The anime will star:

• Tomohiro Ōno as Aia Udagawa

• Chiyuki Miura as Jun Sumisaki

• Nobuhiko Okamoto as Ginga Yoyogi

• Yoshino Aoyama as Oroka Sumeragi

• Momoka Terasawa as Shitataka Sumeragi

Shōtarō Kitamura ( Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! ) is directing the anime at A-1 Pictures , and Takayuki Kikuchi (episode director for Solo Leveling , Kaguya-sama: Love is War ) is the assistant director. Fukurou Kamiza ( Non Non Biyori Nonstop ) is writing and overseeing the series scripts. Honoka Yokoyama ( Oshi no Ko TV 2 , Saint Cecilia and Pastor Lawrence ) is both the character designer and chief animation director, and Tetsuya Kawakami ( A Certain Magical Index , Sword Art Online ) and Reina Iwasaki ( VTuber Legend: How I Went Viral after Forgetting to Turn Off My Stream ) are also chief animation directors. Ryō Yoshimata ( Somali and the Forest Spirit , After the Rain ) is composing the music.

Other staff members include:

• Costume Design: Akane Takeda (A-1 Pictures)

• Prop Design: Takayuki Kidou

• Main Animators: Yūichirō Iida, Marina Kobayashi, Mirai Harashima (A-1 Pictures)

• Hair and Makeup Supervisor: Katsuyoshi Kojima (tron)

• Graphic Illustration: Kashimaki

• Color Design: Mana Hokuto (A-1 Pictures)

• Art Director: Risa Wakabayashi (A-1 Pictures)

• Background Art: Kiya Hirayoshi (A-1 Pictures)

• CG Director: Yuki Kuribayashi

• Director of Photography: Hideki Eto (EXPLOSION)

• Editing: Kiyoshi Hirose

• Sound Director: Kōhei Yoshida

• Sound Effects: Takuya Hasegawa

Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English and it describes the story:

They said Aia was destined to be a model, and Jun was bullied for her freckles. Together, they will take back the power to define themselves in an inspirational fashion manga that asks cutting questions about what it really means to be beautiful—and what it takes to overcome an arbitrary system that seems to respect talent over hard work.

Sonoyama debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Shonen Magazine Edge magazine in 2022, and the series now runs in Monthly Shonen Sirius . Kodansha will publish the ninth volume on October 8. The manga has more than 1.25 million copies in circulation.

Kodansha USA Publishing released the manga's seventh volume on February 10. Kodansha is also releasing the manga digitally on its K MANGA service.

The manga is also inspiring a live-action series that Amazon Prime Video will stream worldwide exclusively in spring 2027.

title: Grandgear Film by Godzilla Minus One's Takashi Yamazaki Opens in January 2028
content:
Sony Pictures announced on Wednesday that Godzilla Minus One director Takashi Yamazaki 's first English-language film Grandgear has moved up its release date from February 18, 2028 to January 14, 2028.

Yamazaki is writing the original screenplay, directing the film, and producing. Bad Robot's J.J. Abrams and Glen Zipper are also producing the film. The film marks Yamazaki's formal entry into the U.S. market, following the success of Godzilla Minus One . The plot of the film is currently unknown.

Sony Pictures announced in April earlier this year that filming will start soon.

Godzilla Minus One opened in Japan on November 3, 2023 ("Godzilla Day"), which was the anniversary of the first Godzilla film's November 3, 1954 release. The film was the third highest-grossing foreign-language film in the United States as of 2024.

Netflix is streaming the film and Godzilla Minus One /Minus Color , the black-and-white version of the film, worldwide.

Godzilla Minus One won the Best Visual Effects award in the 96th Academy Awards in March 2024. The film is the first Japanese film to win in this category, and the first Godzilla film to be nominated for an Oscar.

Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla film , will open in Japan on November 3, and in North America on November 6. This is the first time a Japan-produced Godzilla series film will open in Japan and in North America in the same week. Yamazaki returns as director, screenwriter, and VFX supervisor.

title: Seiji Ebisu's Bishōjo shika Inai Seitokai no Gidai ga Itsumo Ore na Ken Novel Gets Manga Adaptation
content:
The 157th issue of Kadokawa 's Dengeki Daioh G magazine launched the manga adaptation of Seiji Ebisu 's Bishōjo shika Inai Seitokai no Gidai ga Itsumo Ore na Ken (The Case of Me Always Being the Topic of Discussion of the Student Council, Which Only Has Beautiful Girls as Members) novel, on Monday. Tarara is drawing the manga.

The story is set in Minamisawa Academy, where its student council president, Yurina Himesaki, is hailed as the best in the school's history. Led by Yurina, the deeply trusted student council's members are all beautiful girls, and on their agenda every day is romantic advice. With each member hiding herself as the person who is actually seeking romantic advice, Yurina and other student council members are unaware that they are all discussing and seeking advice about their crush Haruhisa Nanjō, a member of the school's Discipline Committee. Unaware of the situation, Haruhisa gets constantly tangled with the student council members' romantic advances.

Kadokawa published Ebisu's novel in April 2025 with illustration by Fuwari.

Ebisu launched the Ore ga Suki nano wa Imōto dakedo Imōto ja nai ( The One I Love is My Little Sister But She's Not a Little Sister ) light novel series with illustrator Gintarō in 2016. Kadokawa published the novels' 11th and final volume in 2020. Kō Narita drew the novels' manga adaptation, which was serialized in Kadokawa 's Dragon Age magazine from 2017 to 2019.

The novels also inspired a television anime adaptation in 2018 with the English title My Sister, My Writer .

title: Super Psychic Policeman Chojo Anime's New Video Previews Ending Song
content:
The staff for the television anime of Shun Numa 's Super Psychic Policeman Chojo ( Chōjun! Chōjō Senpai ) manga started streaming a new promotional video on Thursday, which features the anime's ending theme song "Mata Ashita" (See You Tomorrow) by Shifuku Poncho .

The anime stars:

• Yūsuke Kobayashi as Meguru Chojo

• Riko Aono as Nao Ippongi

• Maria Naganawa as Robo-kun

• Daisuke Ono as Yuki Inukai

• Toshiya Miyata as Hajime Keinain

• Nobuaki Kanemitsu as Hossan

• Kanna Nakamura as Lily Togari

• Kazuki Ura as Heisuke Ban

Junichi Yamamoto ( Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion ; Maebashi Witches ; Anyway, I'm Falling in Love with You ) is directing the anime at Arvo Animation . Hayashi Mori ( Sand Land: The Series , Cells at Work! Code Black , Onmyo Kaiten Re:Birth Verse ) is superivsing and writing series scripts, and Masakatsu Sasaki ( 16bit Sensation: Another Layer , Seiyu's Life! , TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You ) is designing the characters. M!LK performs the opening theme song "That's! Chojo."

Viz Media and Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service started publishing chapters of the manga simultaneously with the Japan release in February 2024. MANGA Plus describes the series:

The creator of Samon the Summoner returns to Jump with a new series about a super-powered policeman! In Chinjuku, the city that never sleeps, there is a psychic senior police officer who has powers beyond human comprehension! His name is Meguru Chojo! Along with his judo expert partner Nao Ippongi, this hilarious duo will keep the streets clean by any means necessary!

The manga was first published as a one-shot story in Weekly Shonen Jump in April 2023, and started serialization in February 2024. The manga ended in June 2025. Shueisha published the manga's final seventh and eighth compiled book volumes in September 2025. Viz Media will publish the manga's sixth volume physically on November 3.

title: Battle in 5 Seconds Manga Resumes
content:
Miyakokasiwa 's Battle in 5 Seconds ( Deatte 5-byō de Battle ) manga (a remake of Saizō Harawata 's original series) resumed on Thursday. Shogakukan had posted the previous chapter on June 11, and the author announced the hiatus on August 13.

The manga went on hiatus due to Miyakokasiwa struggling with poor health.

The manga previously went on hiatus in October 2024, and Miyakokasiwa had noted health and personal issues since the start of 2024. The author added at the time that the series was approaching its end. The manga resumed serialization in January 2025.

Comikey publishes the series in English and describes the story:

Akira Shiroyanagi is a high schooler who loves challenging games and Konpeito candy. One day, while heading to school, he encounters an enigmatic woman called Mi on. After that, Akira and a host of other individuals are kidnapped and forced to become test pilots for a mysterious organization. They are given unique abilities and pitted against each other. Armed with his newfound, special ability, Akira becomes determined to take down this sinister group and beat their game. He has to rely on his guile to overcome all sorts of obstacles in a captivating battle of wits!

Harawata posted the original manga online before artist Miyakokasiwa launched a "remake" of the manga with new art in Shogakukan 's Ura Sunday web comic service in 2015. The manga is also on Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app. Shogakukan published the manga's 31st compiled book volume on July 10.

The series inspired an anime adaptation in 2021. Crunchyroll released an English dub for the series.

title: OceanVeil Announces Simulcast Stream of My Girlfriend's Friend Anime
content:
OceanVeil announced on Thursday that it will simultaneously stream the anime of Jura 's My Girlfriend's Friend ( Kanojo no Tomodachi ) manga, starting on October 4.

OceanVeil describes the anime's story:

Takeru Hidaka thought he had found simple happiness with his sweet, cheerful first girlfriend, Kaori. But his quiet high school life takes an unexpected turn when he meets Kaori's glamorous best friend, Tomoko. Striking, enigmatic, and possessing an effortless allure, Tomoko begins pulling Takeru into her orbit through subtle glances and unexpected closeness. Caught between his genuine feelings for Kaori and the irresistible magnetic pull surrounding Tomoko, Takeru finds his heart and resolve constantly tested. Can he maintain the line of devotion, or will secret desires redefine everything?

title: Shin Oishinbo TV Anime Streams Teaser Video
content:
The official website for Shin Oishinbo (New Oishinbo ), the new television anime series of storywriter Tetsu Kariya and artist Akira Hanasaki 's Oishinbo manga, started streaming the anime's teaser promotional video on Thursday.

The anime will star:

• Yōhei Azakami as Shirō Yamaoka

• Hitomi Sasaki as Yūko Kurita

• Akio Ōtsuka as Yūzan Kaibara

Ken'ichi Nishida ( Good Bye, Dragon Life , Papuwa , Poka Poka Mori no Rascal ) is directing the anime at Synergy SP and Vega Entertainment . Takahiro Nagano ( Reincarnated as a Sword two seasons, Plannosaurus Gachi Koseibutsu Bu ) is in charge of series scripts, and Nozomi Kawashige ( Good Bye, Dragon Life ) is designing the characters. Shinei Animation is in charge of production.

The duo originally launched the manga in 1983. Shogakukan published the 111th volume in December 2014. The manga has been on hiatus since 2014.

The manga depicts the "fierce food showdown" between the newspaper Tōzai Shimbun's "Ultimate Menu" and gourmand Yuzan Kaibara's "Supreme Menu."

A previous television anime adaptation from Shinei Animation aired for 136 episodes from 1988 to 1992. The anime also includes two additional specials.

Viz Media has published five volumes of Oishinbo on its VizManga.com digital manga service and Viz Manga App, and has also published the volumes in print.

The manga has also inspired several live-action series and a live-action film.

title: Netflix to Stream Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Anime
content:
Netflix announced on Thursday that it will stream the Dragon Ball Super: Beerus television anime series. The service will stream the anime in the United States on October 17. The anime is listed to start streaming on October 14 in selected areas/countries.

The first episode will also screen in advance at the Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Special Panel at New York Comic Con on October 8.

The staff for the new anime includes:

• Composition and Direction Arrangement: Matsuto Seya

• Animation Character Design & General Animation Director: Tadayoshi Yamamuro

• Editing: Eiichi Nishimura

• Compositing Director: Yōsuke Motoki

• Music: Norihito Sumitomo

The anime will again feature Kōichi Yamadera as Beerus.

MEGATERA･ZERO performs the opening theme song "ONOGAMI," and VK Blanka performs the ending theme song "Kan Peki No Peki."

Akio Iyoku stated the work started a few years ago and is an "enhanced" edition of the Dragon Ball Super anime that features a reconstruction of the story, and includes new and redrawn cuts.

The official announcement of the anime stated:

The project features extensive new cuts, revisions to existing scenes, a complete re-rendering of all footage, newly recorded dubbing with added score and sound effects, and a full reconstruction of the story. Living up to the name ENHANCED, this edition employs the latest visual expression to deliver greater power and immersion across all scenes, especially the battle sequences. The result is an ENHANCED edition that expresses Akira Toriyama 's original idea and worldbuilding more accurately, that will be broadcasted with highly satisfying quality.

The anime staff stated, "the anime Dragon Ball Super ... is set to begin anew as Dragon Ball Super: Beerus in Fall 2026."

The staff describes the story:

Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep. Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku.Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an Earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his allies—a conflict that will shake the entire universe.

Dragon Ball Super premiered in July 2015 and aired for 131 episodes until March 2018. Funimation and Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired, and Funimation released the series on home video. Funimation debuted the English dub to its streaming service in December 2016. The English dub premiered on Adult Swim 's Toonami block in January 2017.
author: ANN
